title: Mercedes — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API

skills.name: Potion Mastery
skills.description: You learn how to use potions more efficiently in order to resolve supply shortage issues.

skills.name: Deadly Crits
skills.description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Critical Rate.

skills.name: Elven Healing
skills.description: Uses energy purified by nature to continuously recover HP and MP.

skills.name: Updraft
skills.description: Quickly move up on ladders or ropes.

skills.name: Elven Grace
skills.description: Rulers of the Elves are naturally gifted with swift movement, and fatal charms.

skills.name: Crystal Throw
skills.description: Throws a piece of Rue at an enemy.

skills.name: Infiltrate
skills.description:
Allows you to hide and move quickly for a short time.
Cooldown: 1 min

skills.name: Legendary Spirit
skills.description:
[Master Level: 1]
With the aid of a legendary spirit, you can now use scrolls on items that you can't equip.

skills.name: Sylvidia
skills.description:
[Master level: 1]
Allows you to mount the Unicorn Sylvidia, a friend of the Elves.

skills.name: Sylvidia
skills.description:
[Master level: 1]
Allows you to mount the Unicorn Sylvidia, a friend of the Elves. A more mature Sylvidia will appear.

skills.name: Potential Power
skills.description: Activate your hidden powers. Increase movement speed, maximum movement speed, and damage, with a fixed chance of avoiding enemy attacks.

skills.name: Sharp Aim
skills.description: Permanently increases Critical Rate.

skills.name: Swift Dual Shot
skills.description: Fire arrows at multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Spirit Jump
skills.description: Fly a long distance by double-jumping. Press the up key and jump at the same time to move upward. As your skill level increases, so will your jump distance.

skills.name: Spirit Surge
skills.description: Increases Damage and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Parting Shot
skills.description: Fires arrows at enemies launched into the air with Rising Rush. Can only be used after Rising Rush. Can be used with basic attack after using Rising Rush.

skills.name: Dual Bowguns Mastery
skills.description: Increases Dual Bowguns Mastery.

skills.name: Final Attack: Dual Bowguns
skills.description: Chance to deal an additional hit after landing a direct attack skill. Must have Dual Bowguns equipped.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Agile Bowguns
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Dexterity.

skills.name: Piercing Storm
skills.description: Continuously fire arrows containing the power of nature. Arrows can penetrate enemies.

skills.name: Rising Rush
skills.description: Pushes back multiple enemies in front of you and launches them into the air. Other skills can be combined with this one for additional damage. Press the down arrow key to launch the enemy in place instead of pushing them back. Can be linked with Parting Shot, Aerial Barrage, and Rolling Moonsault. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Rising Rush
skills.description: Pushes back multiple enemies in front of you and launches them into the air. Other skills can be combined with this one for additional damage. Press the down arrow key to launch the enemy in place instead of pushing them back. Can be resisted by some monsters. Can be linked with Parting Shot, Aerial Barrage, and Rolling Moonsault.

skills.name: Ignis Roar
skills.description: Utilizes the Spirit of Fire's power to increase your Final Damage and Attack Speed when using linked skills.

skills.name: Aerial Barrage
skills.description:
A combo skill used after lifting enemies into the air with Rising Rush. Fly towards airborne enemies, peppering them with swift attacks. Can also be used by pressing the up key and basic attack after using Rising Rush. Attacks won't knock you back while using the skill.
In addition, permanently increases the damage caused by Rising Rush. Can be linked with Leaf Tornado, Gust Dive, Rolling Moonsault, Spikes Royale, or Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: Stunning Strikes
skills.description: Quickly fire multiple arrows to the front. Can be used in the air and linked with Rising Rush, Unicorn Spike, Spikes Royale, Lightning Edge, or Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: Leaf Tornado
skills.description: Spin in mid-air and fire a hail of arrows all around you. This skill can only be used while in mid-air and can only be used when you are located above a certain height. A higher height is required when using it by linking with Gust Dive. Can be linked with Gust Dive, Spikes Royale, or Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: Unicorn Spike
skills.description: Summons a sacred unicorn to blast through enemies and weaken them for a short time. Weakened enemies take more damage from all attacks. Can be linked with Rising Rush, Stunning Strikes, Spikes Royale, Lightning Edge, or Wrath of Enlil. Using link skills reduces cooldown by 1 sec.

skills.name: Gust Dive
skills.description: Uses the power of wind to dive down onto multiple enemies, dealing damage to all of them. Requires 120 or more Jump. Attacks won't knock you back while using the skill. Can be linked with Rising Rush, Stunning Strikes, Leaf Tornado, Unicorn Spike, Spikes Royale, Lightning Edge, or Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: Water Shield
skills.description: Borrow the power of the spirits to raise a water barrier around you for a short time. The barrier blocks all attacks. Also reduces damage taken, and increases Status Resistance, Elemental Resistance, and Knockback Resistance permanently.

skills.name: Elemental Knights
skills.description:
Summons an Ice Spirit, Fire Spirit, or Shadow Spirit to aid you in battle. When attack lands while Elemental Knights are active, a spirit is summoned. Elemental Knights do not take damage even if they attack enemies with attack reflection.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Elemental Knights
skills.description:
Randomly summons an Ice Spirit, Fire Spirit, or Shadow Spirit to aid you in battle. Elemental Knights do not take damage even if they attack enemies with attack reflection.
Ice Spirit: Has a chance to freeze enemies.
Fire Spirit: Deals continuous fire damage to enemies.
Shadow Spirit: Deals increased damage.

skills.name: Elemental Knights
skills.description:

Ice Spirit: Has a chance to freeze enemies.
Fire Spirit: Deals continuous fire damage to enemies.
Shadow Spirit: Deals increased damage.

skills.name: Dual Bowguns Expert
skills.description: Increases Dual Bowguns Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Defense Break
skills.description: Ignores defenses and increases final and critical damage. Also applies to bosses, and increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters.

skills.name: Advanced Final Attack
skills.description: Permanently increases Attack Power. Greatly increases the damage and activation rate of your Final Attacks.

skills.name: Staggering Strikes
skills.description: Enhances the strength of your Stunning Strikes.

skills.name: Ishtar's Ring - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Ishtar's Ring's damage.

skills.name: Ishtar's Ring - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ishtar's Ring's Monster DEF debuff.

skills.name: Ishtar's Ring - Boss Rush
skills.description: Enhances the Boss Damage of Ishtar's Ring.

skills.name: Water Shield - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Water Shield's damage reduction.

skills.name: Water Shield - True Immunity 1
skills.description: Increases the Abnormal Status Resistance increase from Water Shield.

skills.name: Water Shield - True Immunity 2
skills.description: Increases the Elemental Resistance increase from Water Shield.

skills.name: Spikes Royale - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Spikes Royale's damage.

skills.name: Spikes Royale - Armorbreak
skills.description: Increases the amount of Defense reduced by Spikes Royale. This defense reduction is applied in addition to the base defense reduction granted by Spikes Royale.

skills.name: Spikes Royale - Temper Link
skills.description: Enhance Leaf Tornado's damage boost increased by Spikes Royale. HEXA Leaf Tornado isn't affected by Spikes Royale's passive effect, and is only affected by Spikes Royale - Temper Link's effect.

skills.name: Ishtar's Ring
skills.description: Borrows the power of Ishtar, a legendary weapon, to rapidly fire arrows at enemies ahead of you. Hold down the skill key to fire arrows continuously. In addition, increases damage from Unicorn Spike permanently.

skills.name: Spikes Royale
skills.description: Jump into the air while raining down legendary spears that deal damage to multiple enemies. Decreases enemy DEF, and makes all attacks critical hits. Attacks won't knock you back while using the skill. Also increases damage of Leaf Tornado. The skill can be linked with Leaf Tornado, Gust Dive, Rolling Moonsault, or Wrath of Enlil. Cooldown reduced by 1 sec when a skill is linked.

skills.name: Lightning Edge
skills.description: Dashes through multiple enemies. Also increases damage of Gust Dive. Can be linked with Rising Rush, Stunning Strikes, Unicorn Spike, Spikes Royale, or Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: Ancient Warding
skills.description: For a short time, receive the Ancient Spirit's protection, which increases your Attack Power and HP. Permanently increases the Avoidability and Knockback Resistance of Ignis Roar.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Rolling Moonsault
skills.description:
Spin quickly in the air while attacking enemies. Attacks won't knock you back while using the skill. Can also be used by pressing the down key and basic attack key after using Rising Rush. Can be linked with Leaf Tornado, Gust Dive, Spikes Royale, or Wrath of Enlil.
In addition, the damage caused by Rising Rush and Aerial Barrage will be permanently increased.

skills.name: Spirit Nimble Flight
skills.description: Borrow the spirit's power to dodge out of danger's way.

skills.name: Spirit Nimble Flight
skills.description: Borrow the spirit's power to dodge out of danger's way.

skills.name: Wrath of Enlil
skills.description: Unleashes Enlil's fury on enemies. Cooldown reduced by 1 sec when a Link skill is used. Attacking a boss grants a debuff that ignores collision with that boss for a certain period of time. Can be linked with Rising Rush, Stunning Strikes, Unicorn Spike, Spikes Royale, or Lightning Edge.

skills.name: Heroic Memories
skills.description: Recalls the oath of the Maple Heroes to increase damage.

skills.name: Elvish Blessing
skills.description: Use the blessings of the greatest Elvish minds to dramatically increase Attack Power. Also increases Final Damage permanently.

skills.name: Spirit of Elluel
skills.description: Summons forth the spirits of Elluel to devastate your foes. The spirits' energy and Elluel's form are unaffected by attack reflection. The energy does not activate while attacking with Sylvidia's Flight.

skills.name: Spirit of Elluel
skills.description: Summon forth the spirits of Elluel to devastate your foes. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sylvidia's Flight
skills.description:
Sylvidia, the majestic queen of unicorns swiftly charges at the enemy.
Afterwards, Sylvidia's afterimage attacks the enemy again.
First, Sylvidia's afterimage pierces through the targeted enemy to attack. Then, if there are attackable enemies nearby, the afterimage moves to them, attacking any enemies in its path. After attacking all available enemies within range, Sylvidia's afterimage will target the farthest enemy.
If there is only one enemy to attack, the afterimage1 will return to attack the first enemy, reducing the available attack count by 1.
The afterimage is not affected by attack reflection, and it prioritizes the boss monster with highest HP first.

skills.name: Irkalla's Wrath
skills.description: Deal deadly consecutive attacks against your enemies, so they can experience the full wrath of the spirits. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: Royal Knights
skills.description: Summon the honorable Royal Knights, who protect the Ruler of the Elves. Unaffected by attack reflection. Reusing the skill will end it immediately.

skills.name: HEXA Final Attack
skills.description: Chance to deal an additional hit after landing a direct attack skill. Must have Dual Bowguns equipped.

skills.name: HEXA Ishtar's Ring
skills.description:
Borrows the power of Ishtar, a legendary weapon, to rapidly fire arrows at enemies ahead of you. The arrows pierce through enemies and fire continually when the skill key is held down.
When an enemy is hit with a direct attacking skill (excluding Primeval Spirits), the enemy is branded with Ishtar's Mark. Ishtar's Mark fills up one by one after a certain number of direct attacking skills hit (excluding Primeval Spirits). A powerful spirit attacks every time the mark is filled, and attacks more fiercely when the mark is complete.
Ishtar's Mark can be completed by Spirit of Elluel's afterimage. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Wrath of Enlil
skills.description:
Unleash Enlil's fury on enemies. Attacking a boss grants a debuff that ignores collision with attacked enemies for a set time.
Periodically enhances to HEXA Wrath of Enlil: Spirit Enchant.
Can be linked with Rising Rush, Stunning Strikes, Unicorn Spike, Spikes Royale, and Lightning Edge.
Permanently enhances Ishtar's Mark.

skills.name: HEXA Wrath of Enlil: Spirit Enchant
skills.description:
Unleash Enlil's fury on enemies by channeling ancient spiritual energy. Shares Wrath of Enlil's cooldown.
Attacking a boss grants a debuff that ignores collision with the boss for a certain period of time. Can be linked with Rising Rush, Stunning Strikes, Unicorn Spike. Spikes Royale, and Lightning Edge.

skills.name: HEXA Spikes Royale
skills.description:
Jump into the air while raining down legendary spears that deal damage to multiple enemies. You are immune to knockback while casting the skill. Enemies hit receive a debuff that ignores a set amount of defense.
Periodically enhances to HEXA Spikes Royale: Spirit Enchant.
Can be linked with Leaf Tornado, Gust Dive, Rolling Moonsault, and Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: HEXA Spikes Royale: Spirit Enchant
skills.description:

You are immune to knockback while casting the skill. Enemies hit receive a debuff that ignores a set amount of defense.
Can be linked with Leaf Tornado, Gust Dive, Rolling Moonsault, and Wrath of Enlil.

Periodically enhances to HEXA Leaf Tornado: Spirit Enchant.
Can be linked with Gust Dive, Spikes Royale, and Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: HEXA Leaf Tornado: Spirit Enchant
skills.description:
Spin in mid-air and fire a hail of ancient spiritual arrows all around you.

When in Stationary Mode, the skill can be used on the ground without jumping, but cannot be linked with Gust Dive while on the ground.
Can be linked with Gust Dive, Spikes Royale, and Wrath of Enlil.

skills.name: Unfading Glory
skills.description:
The noble soul of a beloved ruler is granted glory by the Great Spirit and Ancient Spirit King. The powers of the Great Spirit and the Ancient Spirit King bless the weapon of the one destined to fight, and let loose Magic Arrows.
The released spirit power is temporarily made into a form imitating the Spirit King, that fights alongside you. Pressing the skill key again while the Spirit King form exists summons the Spirit King form based on your current location.
The Spirit King form is unaffected by attack reflection.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%
